brief: Screening note on Southeast Asia ethylene supply and H1 2026 price moves

sections.title: Southeast Asia Ethylene Supply Base
questions: What is the current ethylene production capacity in Southeast Asia?
Which companies and plants are the main contributors to regional supply?
Have there been any recent changes or expansions in the supply base since late 2025?
sections.tool_rationale: The plant register provides a structured view of ethylene capacity and plant operators in Southeast Asia, while documents reveal recent expansions, new startups, or operational changes not yet reflected in the register.
sections.unanswerable_if: If the register lacks Southeast Asia ethylene plant data or if no documents discuss recent supply base changes.

sections.title: Recent and Imminent Capacity Changes
questions: What major ethylene capacity additions, expansions, or operational events have occurred in Southeast Asia since late 2025?
Are there any significant turnarounds, debottleneckings, or force majeures affecting supply in this period?
sections.tool_rationale: Documents provide details on recent and upcoming capacity changes, operational events, and disruptions that impact supply.
sections.unanswerable_if: If no documents from late 2025 onward discuss capacity changes, expansions, or operational events for Southeast Asia ethylene plants.

sections.title: Ethylene Price Movement in H1 2026
questions: How did Southeast Asia CFR spot ethylene prices move during H1 2026?
What were the key drivers or events influencing these price changes?
How did price trends in Southeast Asia compare to Northeast Asia in the same period?
sections.tool_rationale: Price series provide the quantitative movement of ethylene prices, while documents (especially industry bulletins) offer context and explanations for observed trends.
sections.unanswerable_if: If the price series for Southeast Asia ethylene is missing for H1 2026 or if no documents discuss price drivers or events in that period.

excluded.reason: ASEAN Petrochemical Monitor explicitly does not publish aggregate regional capacity totals in its bulletins.

excluded.topic: Price forecast or outlook for ethylene after August 2026
excluded.reason: The brief does not request a forecast, and the corpus does not contain forward-looking price assessments or outlooks.
